title: Files
help: Give students several files, such as main.c, sum.c and sum.h. Choose which files are compiled together.
to_single_confirm: Keep only the first compiled file and remove the others?
read_only_help: Students see it but cannot change it.
open_help: Opened as a tab when a student arrives.
compiled_help: Passed to the compiler. Headers are included, not compiled.
delete_help: The file is removed from this draft. Nothing changes for students until you save.
learner_sources_off: Off: only the files ticked “Compiled” above are compiled. A file a student adds is kept but not compiled.
learner_sources_on: On: every .c or .cpp file a student adds is compiled too.
file_tree_closed_help: Students see the files as tabs. The file panel starts closed; the folder button opens it to add, rename, delete or upload files.
file_tree_open_help: Students see the file panel beside the editor from the start, so they can add, rename, delete or upload files right away.
file_tree_disabled_help: Students only edit the tabs you open for them. They cannot add, rename, delete or upload files.
